entries.title: II Samuel 7:1
segments: And it came to pass, when the king dwelt in his house, and Jehovah had given him rest from all his enemies round about,

entries.title: II Samuel 7:2
segments: that the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:3
segments: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thy heart; for Jehovah is with thee.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:4
segments: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of Jehovah came unto Nathan, saying,

entries.title: II Samuel 7:5
segments: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith Jehovah, Shalt thou build me a house for me to dwell in?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:6
segments: for I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:7
segments: In all places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel, spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, Why have ye not built me a house of cedar?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:8
segments: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be prince over my people, over Israel;

entries.title: II Samuel 7:9
segments: and I have been with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee; and I will make thee a great name, like unto the name of the great ones that are in the earth.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:10
segments: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as at the first,

entries.title: II Samuel 7:11
segments: and [as] from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel; and I will cause thee to rest from all thine enemies. Moreover Jehovah telleth thee that Jehovah will make thee a house.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:12
segments: When thy days are fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, that shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:13
segments: He shall build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom for ever.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:14
segments: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: if he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men;

entries.title: II Samuel 7:15
segments: but my lovingkindness shall not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:16
segments: And thy house and thy kingdom shall be made sure for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:17
segments: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:18
segments: Then David the king went in, and sat before Jehovah; and he said, Who am I, O Lord Jehovah, and what is my house, that thou hast brought me thus far?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:19
segments: And this was yet a small thing in thine eyes, O Lord Jehovah; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come; and this [too] after the manner of men, O Lord Jehovah!

entries.title: II Samuel 7:20
segments: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou knowest thy servant, O Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:21
segments: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou wrought all this greatness, to make thy servant know it.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:22
segments: Wherefore thou art great, O Jehovah God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God besides thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:23
segments: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem unto himself for a people, and to make him a name, and to do great things for you, and terrible things for thy land, before thy people, whom thou redeemest to thee out of Egypt, [from] the nations and their gods?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:24
segments: And thou didst establish to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever; and thou, Jehovah, becamest their God.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:25
segments: And now, O Jehovah God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, confirm thou it for ever, and do as thou hast spoken.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:26
segments: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, Jehovah of hosts is God over Israel; and the house of thy servant David shall be established before thee.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:27
segments: For thou, O Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee a house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:28
segments: And now, O Lord Jehovah, thou art God, and thy words are truth, and thou hast promised this good thing unto thy servant:

entries.title: II Samuel 7:29
segments: now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee; for thou, O Lord Jehovah, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.
